synthesis.confidence_reasoning: Sources show complete disagreement on catalyst system (Cu vs Pd) and solvents. ML confidence scores are very low (0.01). Protocol data is incomplete. No clear consensus across sources.

recommended_condition.rationale: Selected Rule-based Pd-catalyzed system as it provides complete reaction parameters. The reaction is a Buchwald-Hartwig amination between bromobenzene and aniline derivative. Pd(PPh3)4 is well-established for C-N coupling of aryl bromides with amines. Potassium carbonate is a mild base suitable for this transformation. 60°C is appropriate for aryl bromides.

backup_conditions.when_to_use: <30% conv: try copper-catalyzed system from ML with elevated temperature
<20% after 12h: switch to more active Pd/XPhos system for challenging couplings

warnings: Ensure anhydrous conditions for Pd catalysis
Aniline derivative may require protection if sensitive to base
Copper systems may require higher temperatures for good conversion
